phases.note: Before: expired grant read the provider, caller budget exceeded the grant, purpose mismatch read. Now one authorizeComposition gate runs before any provider call for every source family; caller budgets are clamped to the grant and reported; zero/negative/NaN/non-integer budgets are invalid_input with zero reads.

Global files/slices/bytes/tokens/duration caps hold under the grant and caller budget; a group with no remaining allocation is skipped instead of forcing one extra read; authorization is re-checked before/after every group and before returning, so mid-composition expiry refuses. Unavailable provider vs caller truncation vs scan_incomplete are distinct; scan_incomplete is fatal; tokens are documented estimates, not billing bounds.

Stable source manifest (sourceId/kind/group/path/contentDigest/baselineCommit/truncated/bytes/tokens/trust) plus omitted/injectionFlagPaths/budgetClamped for main's DTO. Recipe documents the A port adapter, the fixed group order, and the excluded inputs (cross-project/session, contract drift, symlink/credential paths, permission/authentication answers, revoked/superseded decisions). Content stays untrusted_data; no actor/tool fields.

Independent consumers drive main's ProductProposals and its real HTTP: decision proposal confirm writes the decision in the same transaction; reject is terminal with no effectCommandId and no business effect; expired preview and changed grant are rejected with no confirmed state; missing work inputs stay inert; revision without a current work is refused at prepare; a receipt failure rolls back proposal+effect+event+receipt and a retry succeeds; replay returns the same receipt with no second effect; reopen preserves states.

results.performance: PASS p50 ~0.31-0.32ms / p95 ~0.58-0.67ms; 12 slices / 3394 bytes inside a 20-slice / 256KiB budget
